This '''individual''' was a librarian who was captured during a routine police action by [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] on suspicion of being part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. He was severely beaten by battalion [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ivo Laibach]] until [[Unidentified librarian's daughter|his daughter]], in command of a Rebel [[Squad/Legends|squad]], rescued him and the other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. One of the young CompForcers, [[Zevulon Veers]], healed the librarian with a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], and when his daughter took Veers prisoner, he put in a good word for the CompForcer.
